notes:
v4.6.84 — Fix bot preflight installing the framework ("pip install core")

🐛 FIXED
• A generated bot could list APEX's own package `core` (or bundled libs like pandas/numpy/ib_async) in its requirements. The server then ran `pip install core` → "No matching distribution found for core" before every start. The preflight now FILTERS these out — it never tries to install the framework or anything already bundled, so the scary error is gone.
• Make Bot now instructs the AI to leave requirements empty and never list core/pandas/numpy/framework, so future bots don't reintroduce it.

Your energy bot still ran despite that line (core is always importable) — this just removes the noise and the failed install.

Update via the in-app banner.
